messages:
maria: Heads-up: platform proposal to rename `Rd-Route-V2` -> `Rd-Route` (stable) and retire `X-Rd-Route` in SDKs. Need SDK owners + console to agree on telemetry keys and rollout UX.
aj: Rename ok, but killing old header needs a clear compatibility shim. Can we keep server accepting `X-Rd-Route` for a grace window? Also need a tiny helper in Go/TS for parsing.
sasha: Yes on helper + docs. Plan: opt-in flag first, then a deprecation minor with warnings, then remove legacy. Example:
```
# js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: K, routeHeader: 'stable' })
```
chris: Console changes: add a migration dashboard tile that shows per-tenant %legacy, and a churn graph so CS can prioritize outreach. Telemetry keys suggested: `route_header_version` and `route_header_origin`.
leo: devex-bot: py-sdk canary failed on header-less requests (py#789) — will add tolerant parse. Filing ticket.
aj: I'll implement ParseRouteHeader in Go + TS, return (version, origin) and emit a deprecation metric when legacy header seen.
maria: Timeline proposal: announce week 0, opt-in patch week 1, telemetry tile + sampling week 3, server-side fallback DRY-RUN week 6, hard remove week 10. Owners: pls ack with ETA.
sasha: Ack — py/ts snippets + docs by EOD. Go PR Friday.
aj: Ack — Go/TS helper + tests next week.
chris: Ack — console tile + backfill job ETA 2 weeks.
leo: I'll re-run canaries after PRs. devex-bot: reminder set for 4 days to check progress.
